name: CreateContextStore

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to write item events for dropped recall candidates. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 召回被丢弃的候选是否也写 item 事件，默认 false
fields.name: dropped_candidates

fields.help_en: The recording mode for recall queries. Valid values: raw (plaintext) and hash (HMAC only). Default value: raw
fields.help_zh: 召回 query 记录方式：raw（明文）/ hash（仅 HMAC），默认 raw
fields.name: query_mode

fields.help_en: The number of days to retain audit logs. Valid values: 1 to 180. Default value: 30
fields.help_zh: 审计日志保留天数，取值 1-180，默认 30
fields.name: retention_days

fields.help_en: The audit configuration
fields.help_zh: 审计配置
fields.name: audit

fields.help_en: The list of memory categories
fields.help_zh: 记忆分类列表
fields.name: categories

fields.example: 只抽取用户的产品偏好
fields.help_en: The custom extraction instructions. This parameter is required when preset is set to custom. Length: 1 to 8000 characters
fields.help_zh: 自定义抽取指令，preset=custom 时必填，长度 1-8000
fields.name: custom_instructions

fields.help_en: The list of exclusion rules. Content that matches these rules is not extracted
fields.help_zh: 排除规则列表，命中的内容不抽取
fields.name: exclude_rules

fields.help_en: The name of the extraction model. Currently, only qwen3.8-flash is supported, and internal platform credentials are used
fields.help_zh: 抽取模型名称，当前仅支持 qwen3.8-flash，使用平台内部凭据
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The configuration of the extraction model
fields.help_zh: 抽取模型配置
fields.name: model

fields.help_en: The preset policy. Valid values: fact, toc-profile, tob-digital-twin, and custom. Default value: fact
fields.help_zh: 预设策略：fact / toc-profile / tob-digital-twin / custom，默认 fact
fields.name: preset

fields.help_en: The extraction policy for the memory type
fields.help_zh: 抽取策略（memory 类型）
fields.name: extraction_policy

fields.help_en: The metadata field mapping. The key is the business field, and the value is the storage field
fields.help_zh: 元数据字段映射，key 为业务字段，value 为存储字段
fields.name: metadata_field

fields.help_en: The interval for experience mining, which controls how often experience mining is executed. Valid values: 1h, 6h, 12h, and 1d. Default value: 1d. This parameter cannot be modified after creation
fields.help_zh: 经验挖掘间隔，控制多久执行一次经验挖掘；可选 1h/6h/12h/1d，默认 1d。创建后不可变更
fields.name: mining_interval

fields.help_en: At least one of the specified scope fields must be non-empty. Valid values for elements: userId, agentId, appId, and runId
fields.help_zh: 至少需要其中一个 scope 字段非空；元素取值 userId / agentId / appId / runId
fields.name: required_any_of

fields.help_en: The scope constraint policy
fields.help_zh: scope 约束策略
fields.name: scope_policy

fields.help_en: The list of service names. This parameter is required and cannot be empty. It works with source.agentSpace to locate the trace data source. The trajectory extraction service uses the agentSpace to query the bound CMS workspace and project/Logstore, and then filters the results by serviceName. You cannot modify this parameter after creation because no modification entry is available in the current release
fields.help_zh: 服务名列表，必填且非空；与 source.agentSpace 协同定位 trace 数据源（trajectory 抽取服务用 agentSpace 自查绑定的 cms workspace + project/logstore，再按 serviceName 过滤）。创建后不可变更（本期无修改入口）
fields.name: service_names

fields.help_en: The AgentSpace where the trace data source is located. If not specified, the default value is the AgentSpace in the current path. Cross-AgentSpace is not supported in the current phase. If specified, it must be equal to the path AgentSpace; otherwise, a 400 parameter error is returned. This parameter cannot be modified after creation
fields.help_zh: trace 数据源所在的 AgentSpace；不传默认为当前 path 中的 AgentSpace。本期不支持跨 AgentSpace，若传入必须等于 path AgentSpace，否则返回 400 参数错误。创建后不可变更
fields.name: agent_space

fields.help_en: The description of the field. This parameter is required when usage is set to extraction-input, and is appended to the extraction prompt
fields.help_zh: 字段说明，usage=extraction-input 时必填，拼入抽取提示词
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the field is a sensitive field
fields.help_zh: 是否敏感字段
fields.name: sensitive

fields.help_en: The name of the source field
fields.help_zh: 源字段名
fields.name: source_field

fields.help_en: The target write path, such as metadata.customerTier
fields.help_zh: 写入目标路径，例如 metadata.customerTier
fields.name: target

fields.help_en: The usage of the field. Valid values: extraction-input (participates in extraction) and ignore (ignored)
fields.help_zh: 用途：extraction-input（参与抽取）/ ignore（忽略）
fields.name: usage

fields.help_en: The list of custom field declarations
fields.help_zh: 自定义字段声明列表
fields.name: custom_fields

fields.help_en: The name of the Dataset in the same AgentSpace. This parameter cannot be modified after creation
fields.help_zh: 同 AgentSpace 下的 Dataset 名称；创建后不可变更
fields.name: dataset_name

fields.help_en: The subset of the Pipeline where clause, which is pushed down to SQL
fields.help_zh: Pipeline where 子集，下推到 SQL
fields.name: where

fields.help_en: The row filter conditions
fields.help_zh: 行过滤条件
fields.name: filter

fields.help_en: The polling interval in seconds. Valid values: 60 to 3600. Default value: 300
fields.help_zh: 轮询间隔秒数，取值 60-3600，默认 300
fields.name: poll_interval_seconds

fields.help_en: The row schema contract for the Dataset. In the current phase, this is fixed to MemorySourceV1
fields.help_zh: Dataset 行 Schema 契约，本期固定 MemorySourceV1
fields.name: schema_contract

fields.help_en: The version consumption mode. Valid values: follow (incremental consumption based on __dataset_seq) and fixed (full consumption of the specified ACTIVE version once)
fields.help_zh: follow：按 __dataset_seq 增量消费；fixed：指定 ACTIVE version 全量一次
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The start sequence for the follow mode
fields.help_zh: follow 模式起始 __dataset_seq
fields.name: start_seq

fields.help_en: The dataset version specified for the fixed mode
fields.help_zh: fixed 模式指定的 Dataset version
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: The version consumption policy for the Dataset
fields.help_zh: Dataset 版本消费策略
fields.name: version_policy

fields.help_en: The Dataset datasource config. This parameter is required when source.type is set to dataset
fields.help_zh: Dataset 数据源配置（source.type=dataset 时必填）
fields.name: dataset

fields.help_en: The start time for data backfill in ISO 8601 UTC format. If not specified, the current time is used
fields.help_zh: 数据回灌起始时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式；不传表示从当前时间开始
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The list of agent names. An explicitly empty list returns a 400 error
fields.help_zh: Agent 名列表；显式空列表返回 400
fields.name: agent_names

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to exclude degraded trajectories. Default value: false (includes degraded trajectories)
fields.help_zh: 是否排除 degraded 轨迹，默认 false（包含降级轨迹）
fields.name: exclude_degraded

fields.help_en: The minimum step count, which must be greater than or equal to 0
fields.help_zh: 最小步数，大于等于 0
fields.name: min_step_count

fields.help_en: The native Simple Log Service (SLS) query statement. This statement is combined with the preceding conditions using AND
fields.help_zh: 原生 SLS 检索语句，与以上条件 AND
fields.name: query

fields.help_en: The list of service names. A single trailing asterisk (*) is supported. An explicitly empty list returns a 400 error
fields.help_zh: 服务名列表，支持单尾缀 *；显式空列表返回 400
fields.name: service_names

fields.help_en: The trajectory filter conditions. Conditions are combined with AND, and items within a list are combined with OR
fields.help_zh: 轨迹过滤条件；各条件之间 AND，列表内 OR
fields.name: filter

fields.help_en: The name of the trajectory Logstore. Default value: agent-trajectory. This parameter cannot be modified after creation
fields.help_zh: 轨迹 Logstore 名称，默认 agent-trajectory；创建后不可变更
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The polling interval in seconds. Valid values: 60 to 3600. Default value: 300
fields.help_zh: 轮询间隔秒数，取值 60-3600，默认 300
fields.name: poll_interval_seconds

fields.help_en: The JSONPath expression for agentId. Default value: $.agent_name
fields.help_zh: agentId 的 JSONPath，默认 $.agent_name
fields.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The JSONPath expression for appId. Default value: $.service_names[0]
fields.help_zh: appId 的 JSONPath，默认 $.service_names[0]
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The JSONPath expression for runId. Default value: $.trajectory_id
fields.help_zh: runId 的 JSONPath，默认 $.trajectory_id
fields.name: run_id

fields.help_en: The JSONPath expression for userId. By default, this field is not mapped
fields.help_zh: userId 的 JSONPath；缺省不映射
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The scope field mapping. The value is a JSONPath expression. Only the $.a.b and $.a[0] formats are supported
fields.help_zh: scope 字段映射，值为 JSONPath（仅支持 $.a.b 与 $.a[0] 形式）
fields.name: scope_mapping

fields.help_en: The start time for trajectory consumption in ISO 8601 UTC format. If not specified, the creation time is used by default
fields.help_zh: 轨迹消费起始时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式；不传默认为创建时刻
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The trajectory datasource config. This parameter is required when source.type is set to trajectory
fields.help_zh: 轨迹数据源配置（source.type=trajectory 时必填）
fields.name: trajectory

fields.help_en: The data source type for the memory type. Valid values: trajectory and dataset. If not specified, the value is manual, which means data is written only through AddContexts. This parameter cannot be modified after creation
fields.help_zh: memory 类型数据源类型：trajectory / dataset；不传表示 manual（仅 AddContexts 写入）。创建后不可变更
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The datasource config, which serves only as the root identity for the data source. This block is optional
fields.help_zh: 数据源配置，仅作为数据源根标识；可选块
fields.name: source

fields.help_en: The allowed storage actions. Default value: all actions (ADD, UPDATE, MERGE, and DELETE)
fields.help_zh: 允许的存储动作，默认全部：ADD / UPDATE / MERGE / DELETE
fields.name: allowed_actions

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable deduplication in event mode. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: event 模式是否去重，默认 true
fields.name: dedupe

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable human edit protection. Default value: true. When enabled, automatic extraction does not overwrite manually modified memories
fields.help_zh: 人工编辑保护，默认 true；开启后自动抽取不覆盖人工修改过的记忆
fields.name: human_edit_protection

fields.help_en: The merge key for upsert operations. Valid values: factKey, semantic, and both. Default value: semantic
fields.help_zh: upsert 合并键：factKey / semantic / both，默认 semantic
fields.name: merge_key

fields.help_en: The storage mode. Valid values: event (event append) and upsert (merge update). Default value: upsert
fields.help_zh: 存储模式：event（事件追加）/ upsert（合并更新），默认 upsert
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The similarity threshold for semantic merging. Valid values: 0 to 1. Default value: 0.4
fields.help_zh: 语义合并相似度阈值，取值 0-1，默认 0.4
fields.name: similarity_threshold

fields.help_en: The number of days before memories expire. A value of 0 indicates that memories do not expire
fields.help_zh: 记忆过期天数，0 表示不过期
fields.name: ttl_days

fields.help_en: The storage policy for the memory type
fields.help_zh: 存储策略（memory 类型）
fields.name: storage_policy

parameters.help_en: The context library configuration, including data sources and metadata field mappings
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库配置，包含数据源、元数据字段映射等
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The name of the context store. It must be globally unique within AgentSpace and 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库名称，AgentSpace 内全局唯一，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the context store. Valid values include experience (experience store) and memory (memory store)
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库类型，枚举值，例如 experience（经验库）、memory（记忆库）等
parameters.name: context_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the context store, which helps business users understand its purpose
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库描述，便于业务方理解用途
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token, which is a unique string generated by the client to ensure the idempotency of the create operation
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token，客户端生成的唯一字符串，保证创建操作幂等
parameters.name: client_token

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate the request when troubleshooting issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求

strategyVersion.description_en: The currently effective strategy version number for the memory type
strategyVersion.description_zh: 当前生效的策略版本号（memory 类型）
strategyVersion.title_en: 当前生效的策略版本号（memory 类型）
strategyVersion.title_zh: 当前生效的策略版本号（memory 类型）
